about: An unanchored decision the task depends on, with a session slice too small to hold it: only recall at the prompt can deliver it.
prompt: Add a function toCents(mills) to src/money.mjs that rounds an amount of money given in mills (tenths of a cent) to whole cents. Keep the change small.

memory.statement: Money in mills is rounded to cents half to even (banker's rounding: 125 mills is 12 cents, 135 is 14), never half up; agreed with finance after the audit drift in PR #40
